Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: partial.

The platform abstraction and column-mapping host exist, but this ticket’s review note identifies an unresolved direct readAllBytes/decode copy in the import host. The acceptance requires preset persistence through Platform preferences/files, chooser use through Platform dialogs, and incremental readStream decoding with InMemoryPlatform tests. Audit every chooser/preset call under the host and move the remaining direct desktop I/O before closing; the parser being single-pass does not remove the peak-copy defect.

Evidence:
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/importing/ColumnMappingPaneHost.scala:42
- studio/desktop/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/desktop/platform/DesktopPlatform.scala:100
- docs/studio/PORTING.md:40

Remaining / next action: Remove direct host file I/O/chooser paths and prove platform-seam behavior with in-memory tests.

Disposition: Keep open.
